title: Blue Room Spell
style: Power jazz ballad with swinging 6/8 pulse, smoky upright bass, brushed drums, and knife-bright piano stabs; verse leans intimate and sparse, pre-chorus widens with rising horns and tremolo guitar, chorus opens into bold stacked harmonies and trumpet answers. Lead vocal is close-mic and trembling in verses, then belted with doubled lines and loose ad-libs on the hook. Tape hiss, reversed cymbal swells, and a late-solo sax turn give it a haunted glow; mix is wide, dark, and satin-smooth., jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You walked in with rain on your coat
A secret grin and a busted note
My glass went still in my hand
Like the whole room knew your name

You said, "Don't mind me, I just stay"
But your eyes stayed on my face
And I swear the air turned slow
When you laughed through the smoke

[Pre-Chorus]
Then your smile cut right through me
Like a match in a blacked-out hall
I tried to act like nothing
But I felt that whole thing fall

[Chorus]
I am gone, I am gone
On the sound of your name
I am gone, I am gone
And I want the burn again
Stay close, stay close
Let the dark learn my skin
I am gone, I am gone
And I'm falling in love again
(falling in love again)

[Verse 2]
You traced my palm like a map
Said, "You look like trouble, babe"
I should've run for the door
But I stayed right in that ache

Now every room feels smaller
If you're not standing there
And every song gets haunted
By the way you say my prayer

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you lean in, slow as thunder
And my doubt starts coming apart
I didn't know a life could split
At the beat of one soft heart

[Chorus]
I am gone, I am gone
On the sound of your name
I am gone, I am gone
And I want the burn again
Stay close, stay close
Let the dark learn my skin
I am gone, I am gone
And I'm falling in love again
(falling in love again)

[Bridge]
[Horn break]
If this is the wreck, let it be
If this is the flood, carry me
You are the hymn in my bones
The one I never meant to know

[Final Chorus]
I am gone, I am gone
On the sound of your name
I am gone, I am gone
And I want the burn again
Stay close, stay close
Let the dark learn my skin
I am gone, I am gone
And I'm falling in love again
(falling in love again)
(I am gone)
